name: Handwheel torque
input: Handwheel torque data from the sensor
description: The sensed handwheel torque data is processed and converted to engineering units

name: Pinion angle
input: Handwheel position data; Motor angle data
description: The data is processed and converted to engineering units to provide the pinion angle

name: Motor angle
input: Data from the motor angle sensor (Part of motor sensong sub-system)
description: The data is processed and converted into engineering units to provide the motor angle

name: Motor velocity
input: Data from the motor angle sensor (Part of motor sensong sub-system)
description: Processing of the data to estimate the motor velocity

name: Temperature
input: ECU temperature data; Ambient temperature data
description: Process the ECU temperature data and the ambient temperature data and provide an estimate for the system temperature

name: Motor current
input: Data from the motor current monitoring component
description: Data is processed and converted to corresponding engineering units

name: Vehicle communications
input: Data from the vehicle ECU (Vehicle Signals); Data from the steering system (System Signals)
description: Communicate with the vehicle ECU. That is send system signals and receive vehicle signals as required
output: Two way communication between the system and the vehicle is established

name: Supply voltage
input: Vehicle power supply
description: Receive, distribute and regulate (if required) the vehicle power supply throughout the system where required; Monitor the vehicle power supply and determine the battery voltage, bridge voltage
output: Power supply received, distributed and regulated (if necessary) within the system; Battery voltage, bridge voltage

name: Calculate torque overlay command
input: Handwheel torque data; Pinion angle data; Vehicle signals
description: Based on vehicle assist commands and for executing active return feature, calculate a torque overlay command
output: Motor torque command overlay; Handwheel torque overlay

name: Calculate torque command modifiers
input: Handwheel torque data; Pinion angle data; Estimated motor velocity data; Vehicle signals
description: Based on the input, determine the forces (external and internal) acting on the steering system which needs to be compensated and calculate modifiers for the torque command to achieve this compensation

name: Calculate motor torque command limit
input: Motor current value; Battery voltage data; Bridge voltage data; Estimated system temperature value
description: Check for power supply & system temperature and calculate limits for the motor torque command to protect the system
output: Motor torque command limit; Motor torque command scalar

name: Calculate motor torque command
input: Motor torque command overlay; Handwheel torque overlay; Motor torque command modifier; Motor torque command limit
description: From the torque command overlays, modifiers and limits, calculate the motor torque command with the required motor torque value to provide intended assist

name: Calculate motor voltage command
input: Motor torque command
description: Interpret the motor torque command in terms of the motor characteristics and come up with a motor voltage command

name: Generate motor voltage
input: Motor voltage command
description: Generate motor voltage as per the motor voltage command

name: Provide motor torque
input: Motor voltage
description: Operate the motor, generate torque and provide the generated torque as assistance

name: Diagnostics
description: Conduct a system level diagnostics to determine the health of the system and in turn help determint the state in which the system should operate

name: States and Modes
description: The system behaviour is captured as system states and modes
output: System states and modes, their transitions and conditions for transitions are defined

name: Handwheel torque measurement
input: Handwheel torque signal from the driver sensor
description: The handwheel torque signal is received and measured by the electric hardware
output: Received and measured handwheel torque signal

name: Handwheel torque calculation and diagnostics
input: Received and measured handwheel torque signal
description: The handwheel torque signal is converted to engineering units and it is checked for its validity
output: Handwheel torque data; Handwheel torque data validity information

name: Pinion angle measurement
input: Handwheel position signal from the handwheel position sensor
description: The pinion angle signal is received and measured by the electric hardware
output: Received and measured pinion angle signal

name: Pinion angle calculation
input: Received and measured pinion angle signal
description: The pinion angle signal is converted to engineering units

name: Sense motor angle
description: Motor angle is sensed by means of a motor angle sensor
output: Motor angle signal; Motor turns count

name: Motor angle measurement
input: Motor angle signal; Motor turns count
description: The motor angle signal is received and measured by the electric hardware
output: Received and measured motor angle signal

name: Motor angle calculations and diagnostics
input: Received and measured motor angle signal
description: The motor angle signal is converted to engineering units and it is checked for its validity
output: Motor angle data; Motor angle data validity information

name: Provide motor velocity estimation
input: Motor angle data
description: The motor velocity is estimated by the rate of change of the sensed, measured and calculated motor angle data

name: Temperature measurement
input: Temperature of the control module board
description: The temperature of the control module board is measured by means of a thermistor; The measured temperature value is calculated to come up with the ECU temperature data

name: Temperature calculation
input: ECU temperature
description: The motor temperature and the mechanical actuator temperature are estimated from the measured and calculated ECU temperature data
output: Mechanical actuator temperature estimation; Motor temperature estimation

name: Motor current measurement
description: The motor current is meaured by means of a measuring component in the electric hardware

name: Motor current arbitration and diagnostics
input: Measured motor current signal
description: The measured motor current signal is converted to engineering units and it is checked for its validity
output: Motor current data; Motor current data validity information

name: Generate motor torque
input: Generated motor voltage
description: The electric motor generates the motor torque based on the voltage supplied to it
output: Generated motor torque which acts as the assistance to the driver's steering effort
